title: 2,004 calls, 238 hours & one final 'signal': How Pune businessman's murder unfolded
summary: A chilling conspiracy has emerged in the death of real estate businessman Ketan Agarwal, allegedly orchestrated by his fiancée Siya Goyal and her lover Chetan Chaudhary. Investigators revealed months of secret communication and repeated attempts to lure Agarwal to Lohagad Fort before his fatal fall.
